_comment: How the room offers its panels, on every surface (the owner, 2026-09-25: two settings, 'one for the panels and one for the look of the selection of them', and a new character-select 'scroll' as the default; 'on the car, phone, console, desktop ... it should all match'). Since 2026-10-08 the default is 'none' ("clean it ALL up"): the console offers panels from its corner launcher only; the phone's native HUD, which has no corner launcher, shows its compact shelf for 'none'. aura-web/src/lib/hud/arrangement.ts + map/marks.ts + map/scrollLook.ts and android-app glass/Selection.kt each keep a table; both suites compare it with this file.
